tools.name: flow_search
tools.returns: Search underlyings by ticker fragment

tools.name: list_active_underlyings
tools.returns: Every underlying that traded options on a date, ranked by premium

tools.name: expirations
tools.returns: Available expiration dates for an underlying, with contract counts

tools.name: flow_feed
tools.returns: Recent scored trades (Flow Score, FlowBonus) + VWF/SDF/FIR aggregates

tools.name: trade_score
tools.returns: Full scoring + context for one trade id (from a `flow_feed` row)

tools.name: aggregate_score
tools.returns: Composite + VWF/SDF/FIR across one or more trailing timeframes

tools.name: flow_aggregate
tools.returns: Server-side rollup over an arbitrary `[start_time, end_time]` window

tools.name: sweeps
tools.returns: Aggregated multi-exchange sweeps with venues, premium, moneyness, score

tools.name: flow_momentum
tools.returns: Live 5m/30m/1h flow vs trailing baseline, with z-scores + trend label

tools.name: flow_baseline
tools.returns: Trailing per-time-of-day baseline `flow_momentum` compares against

tools.name: flow_strikes
tools.returns: Top-N strikes by net/total premium with bull/bear split + OI context

tools.name: flow_tide
tools.returns: Bucketed bullish vs bearish premium with cumulative net premium

tools.name: by_strike
tools.returns: Strike-level distribution of a day's flow, optionally by DTE band

tools.name: top_underlyings_daily
tools.returns: Top underlyings by single-day flow (call/put split, net premium, ratio)

tools.name: top_underlyings_weekly
tools.returns: Same, over the trailing week

tools.name: top_contracts_daily
tools.returns: Single-day top-contract screener (premium / volume / OI / sweeps)

tools.name: top_contracts_weekly
tools.returns: Same, over the trailing week

tools.name: unusual_volume
tools.returns: Contracts with anomalous volume vs an `avg_period` baseline (RVOL)

tools.name: unusual_oi
tools.returns: Contracts with significant open-interest changes (opening vs closing)

tools.name: chain_bull_bear
tools.returns: Chain-level bull/bear/neutral % with call- and put-only breakdowns

tools.name: contract_bull_bear
tools.returns: Bull/bear/neutral % for a single OPRA contract

tools.name: chain_ratio
tools.returns: Chain-level ask/bid/mid + aggression ratios with a bias interpretation

tools.name: contract_ratio
tools.returns: Same bid/ask/mid pressure for a single OPRA contract

tools.name: underlying_stats
tools.returns: Daily aggregate stats for an underlying (premium, volume, net, OI)

tools.name: underlying_bulk_stats
tools.returns: One-day stats (premium, volume, call/put split, net premium) for up to 50 tickers in one call; tickers with no options activity are absent

tools.name: contract_bulk_stats
tools.returns: One-day stats for up to 50 option contracts (OPRA symbols) in one call

tools.name: underlying_history
tools.returns: Daily options-flow history for a ticker, one row per trading day (premium, volume, call/put split, net premium)

tools.name: contract_history
tools.returns: Daily history for one contract: premium, volume, OI change, bid/ask split, sweep and multi-leg share, VWAP, last price, IV, trade count

tools.name: flow_historical_compare
tools.returns: Today's flow vs its trailing 20-trading-day average: deltas, percentile ranks and the five most similar past days

tools.name: contract_stats
tools.returns: Daily aggregate stats for a contract (volume, OI, premium, IV)

tools.name: vol_oi
tools.returns: Vol/OI accumulation analysis; distinguishes new positioning from closing

tools.name: moneyness
tools.returns: Premium/sentiment split across deep_itm…deep_otm + detected patterns

tools.name: option_chain
tools.returns: Full chain at an expiration (per-strike call/put volume, OI, premium)

tools.name: underlying_chart
tools.returns: Intraday OHLC-style bars for an underlying

tools.name: contract_chart
tools.returns: Intraday OHLC-style bars for a single contract

tools.name: underlying_rvol
tools.returns: Relative-volume bars for an underlying (`format=summary` for stats only)

tools.name: contract_rvol
tools.returns: Relative-volume bars for a single contract

tools.name: flux_field
tools.returns: Flux Field level with its inner, outer and extreme bands for an underlying (latest 100 points unless `limit` is set)

tools.name: market_overview
tools.returns: Market-wide flow for the day + top tickers by premium

tools.name: market_tide
tools.returns: Bucketed net call/put premium time series with an SPY overlay

tools.name: market_breadth
tools.returns: SPY/QQQ/IWM sentiment, advance/decline, per-sector rotation

tools.name: sector_flow
tools.returns: Sector/industry flow aggregation with top-contributor tickers

tools.name: dark_pool_trades
tools.returns: Paginated off-exchange prints (filters: tickers / date range / notional / venue / sector); `$1M+` by default, span capped at 31 days

tools.name: dark_pool_top_prints
tools.returns: Top-N largest prints for a ticker over a trailing window, ordered by notional

tools.name: heat_heatmap
tools.returns: Current per-strike gamma/vanna heatmap + live velocity (multi-symbol)

tools.name: heat_levels
tools.returns: Key levels only: classified nodes (king, gatekeeper, pika, barney, significant), strongest first, with distance from spot

tools.name: heat_historical_heatmap
tools.returns: Replay the heatmap at a past instant (back to 2023-03-28)

tools.name: heat_stats_daily
tools.returns: Daily gamma/vanna stats for up to 50 symbols over up to 31 days (400 symbol-days): spot OHLC, largest positive and negative strike exposure, concentration

tools.name: heat_symbols
tools.returns: Every symbol with gamma/vanna data: index flag, previous tickers after a rename, available metrics and history date range

tools.name: tempest_iv
tools.returns: Constant-maturity IV (SVX) at 1d/9d/30d/3m/6m, IV rank and percentiles, ratio to the VIX, term slope and mean-reversion odds

tools.name: tempest_term
tools.returns: Implied vol per listed expiry, for contango/backwardation reads

tools.name: tempest_cones
tools.returns: The 1-sigma move priced from the current price to today's close, 1 day, the week, monthly opex and 30 days, as percent and price bands, with the upside and downside moves as skew prices them and the scheduled events inside each horizon (earnings, FOMC, CPI, NFP); plus fixed day, week and month ranges priced at a past close

tools.name: tempest_sigma
tools.returns: Today's move in units of the one-day move priced at the prior close, move budget left, odds of 1- and 2-sigma days, last 60 sessions

tools.name: tempest_surface
tools.returns: 30-day 25-delta risk reversal and butterfly, ATM vol, skew percentile, a per-symbol SKEW index and the smile per expiry

tools.name: tempest_tilt
tools.returns: One-strike-OTM call vs put imbalance (raw and forward-adjusted), the cheap side, z-score and percentile

tools.name: tempest_events
tools.returns: Next earnings date and timing, implied event move vs past realized moves, VRP and 20-day realized vol

tools.name: tempest_snapshot
tools.returns: Every Tempest module in one call (iv, term, cones, sigma, surface, tilt, events)

tools.name: tempest_market
tools.returns: VIX1D/9D/VIX/3M/6M, VVIX and SKEW from SPX and VIX chains, curve state and roll, regime, Mag-7 dispersion, Fear & Greed

tools.name: tempest_screener
tools.returns: Radar: screen every covered symbol on IV rank, SVX percentiles, ratio to VIX, skew, tilt, expected move, sigma, day pace and vol repricing, earnings, VRP; up to 500 rows

tools.name: tempest_history
tools.returns: One row per stored session at its close (OHLC, SVX per tenor, ATM vol, term slope, skew, tilt, chain depth, and the 1-sigma move priced for the next session: `em_1d_pct`, `em_1d`, `range_1d_low` / `range_1d_high`, `em_1d_event`), up to about two years
tools.credits: 1 per 10 symbol-weekdays in the window, min 1 (3 for 1 symbol x 1 month)

tools.name: tempest_derived
tools.returns: One year daily: 20-day realized vol, VRP series and percentile, the SVX30 usual-range band, earnings-eve sessions, spot-vol correlation

tools.name: tempest_status
tools.returns: When Tempest last computed, the session it belongs to, whether it is serving the frozen close, market state and coverage counts

tools.name: tempest_symbols
tools.returns: Every symbol Tempest covers, with its latest asOf and last stored daily session

tools.name: nexus_journal_stats
tools.section: Nexus: your own simulated trading journal
tools.returns: Headline figures over a range: trades, measured trades, wins, losses, win rate, net P&L, average win and loss, profit factor, best and worst trade, consistency, green and red days

tools.name: nexus_journal_growth
tools.section: Nexus: your own simulated trading journal
tools.returns: The account's cash balance at the end of each day it moved, with net change and max drawdown (a cash curve, not equity: open positions are not marked)

tools.name: nexus_journal_breakdown
tools.section: Nexus: your own simulated trading journal
tools.returns: Closed trades split along one dimension (`by`: duration, session, weekday, direction, ticker, playbook, orderType, exitOrderType), with best and worst only from 5 measured trades

tools.name: nexus_journal_calendar
tools.section: Nexus: your own simulated trading journal
tools.returns: One month of realized days with month totals; a day or month with nothing measured is `null`, not 0

tools.name: nexus_journal_daily
tools.section: Nexus: your own simulated trading journal
tools.returns: One New York trading day (`date`, default today): the day's stats, the cash carried in, what the day did to the cash, every cash move in order, and the trades that finished that day (the same rows as `nexus_trades` with that `exitDay`). A day with nothing finished is `stats` null, never a row of zeros

tools.name: nexus_journal_behaviour
tools.section: Nexus: your own simulated trading journal
tools.returns: How you manage trades, all time: capture rate, upside missed after the exit, giveback from the peak and drawdown while held, each with its sample size (a figure whose sample is 0 is null: not measured, never 0)

tools.name: nexus_journal_recap
tools.section: Nexus: your own simulated trading journal
tools.returns: Your recap for one season Arc (`arc` 1 to 4 and `year`, or the Arc in progress): trades, win rate, net P&L, profit factor, green and red days, best day, trade, ticker and session, green streak and curve; `complete` is false while the Arc is running

tools.name: nexus_journal_execution
tools.section: Nexus: your own simulated trading journal
tools.returns: What your fills cost against the quoted mid at fill time: fills measured out of all fills, average spread width and slippage, total slippage cost, and that cost as a share of gross profit (no upper bound, so read it with gross profit), split into buys and sells

tools.name: nexus_agent_edge
tools.section: Nexus: your own simulated trading journal
tools.returns: Your bot's Edge and Proven Edge over its account or one extra port

tools.name: nexus_agent_rank
tools.section: Nexus: your own simulated trading journal
tools.returns: Your bot's rank, private to you, for the Bot or one extra port: tier, division, EP, placement, series and shield, the next tier and each of its criteria (met or missing). Main is refused (your own rank is `nexus_my_rank`); `{"enabled": false}` when agent ranks are off, which is not a rank of zero

tools.name: nexus_trades
tools.section: Nexus: your own simulated trading journal
tools.returns: Your simulated trades (options and stocks), with the latest mark on open ones. `status`: `open`, `closed` (trades you closed, leaving out options that expired), `expired` (only those), `settled` (closed and expired: the trades your calendar and stats count) or `all` (default). `exitDay` (YYYY-MM-DD, New York): only trades that finished that day, the same day as the calendar

tools.name: nexus_spreads
tools.section: Nexus: your own simulated trading journal
tools.returns: Your open option spreads on your main account: strategy, debit or credit, open price and mark, unrealized and realized P&L, collateral, the exit plan and each leg. A mark is null until every leg has one; `feature_disabled` when spreads are not open for you, which is not an empty book

tools.name: nexus_spread_history
tools.section: Nexus: your own simulated trading journal
tools.returns: Your closed and settled option spreads, newest closed first: open and close price, realized P&L and percent, why it closed (you, the desk or expiry) and each leg's open and close

tools.name: nexus_playbooks
tools.section: Nexus: your own simulated trading journal
tools.returns: Your setups for one account (`agent`, the default here, or `main`; each account has its own): name, description, color and rules, archived ones only with `includeArchived`

tools.name: nexus_trade_playbook
tools.section: Nexus: your own simulated trading journal
tools.returns: The setup one of your trades is tagged with (`tradeId` from `nexus_trades`) and which of its rules you followed; a trade with no setup is `tag` null

tools.name: nexus_ports
tools.section: Nexus: your own simulated trading journal
tools.returns: Your ports: id, name, kind, account, cash, realized P&L, open count, limits

tools.name: nexus_journal_notes
tools.section: Nexus: your own simulated trading journal
tools.returns: The days in one month (`month` YYYY-MM, default this month) you wrote a journal note about; a month with no note is an empty list

tools.name: nexus_journal_note
tools.section: Nexus: your own simulated trading journal
tools.returns: What you wrote about one trading day (`day` YYYY-MM-DD); a day you never wrote about is `data` null, not an empty note

tools.name: nexus_journal_passed
tools.section: Nexus: your own simulated trading journal
tools.returns: The trades you saw and chose not to take, with your reasons and how they would have worked, for a `month` or a `from` and `to` range (at most 400 days); a field you left blank is null

tools.name: nexus_my_rank
tools.section: Nexus: your own simulated trading journal
tools.returns: Your own member rank, the one on your profile: tier, division, EP, positions counted, Edge figures, placement, series, shield and progress to the next tier. `{"enabled": false}` until ranks are on for you, which is not a rank of zero

tools.name: nexus_my_rank_form
tools.section: Nexus: your own simulated trading journal
tools.returns: Your recent form on your member rank: one print per recent position (green, red or scratch), your run, best and worst, and recent positions against your normal

tools.name: nexus_my_rank_chart
tools.section: Nexus: your own simulated trading journal
tools.returns: Your member rank as a line over time (`range` `3m`, `1y` default, or `all`), with placement, promotions and demotions, and your pace to the next tier (null when there is no steady climb, not a pace of 0)

tools.name: nexus_my_rank_events
tools.section: Nexus: your own simulated trading journal
tools.returns: Your member rank's events, newest first: placement, promotions, demotions, series, shields and EP moves, with the figures each was worked out from

tools.name: nexus_my_agents
tools.section: Nexus: your own simulated trading journal
tools.returns: Your own agent profiles as you see them in Nexus: name, link, picture, bio, strategy tags and who can see them, plus every strategy tag there is; none yet is an empty list

tools.name: nexus_futures_trades
tools.section: Nexus: your own simulated trading journal
tools.returns: Every futures trade (flat to flat) closed in one month of futures trading days, newest first, with each day's result and the month's totals (money in US cents)

tools.name: nexus_futures_stats
tools.section: Nexus: your own simulated trading journal
tools.returns: Headline figures over a range: trades, net, fees, win rate, profit factor, expectancy, largest win and loss, points per contract, hold and streaks, the equity curve, and splits by instrument, side, hour, weekday, hold time and account, each with its trade count (money in US cents)

tools.name: nexus_futures_behaviour
tools.section: Nexus: your own simulated trading journal
tools.returns: How you trade futures over a range: where your expectancy comes from, how one trade changes the next, size and adding to a loser, a daily stop what-if, and how far trades went for and against you (medians over trades with a recorded path; money in US cents)

tools.name: nexus_futures_recap
tools.section: Nexus: your own simulated trading journal
tools.returns: One account's trading day (`date`, default the last day that closed): net, trades, wins, losses, best and worst trade, deepest point, daily limit used, end balance and that day's account events (money in US cents)

tools.name: nexus_futures_events
tools.section: Nexus: your own simulated trading journal
tools.returns: Everything that happened to one futures account, oldest first: started, daily lock, failed, passed, funded, payout, reset, with balance and equity at the time in US cents

tools.name: nexus_futures_evaluations
tools.section: Nexus: your own simulated trading journal
tools.returns: Your evaluations by calendar quarter in New York time and in total: started, passed, blown, daily locks and pass rate (null for a quarter in which none ended, not 0%), how many are running and the 20 most recent events

tools.name: nexus_futures_trip
tools.section: Nexus: your own simulated trading journal
tools.returns: One futures trade in full (`tripId` from `nexus_futures_trades`): its fills, the path price took while it was open, and how far that went for and against you; exit figures are null while it is open (money in US cents)

tools.name: nexus_trade
tools.section: Nexus: your own simulated trading journal
tools.returns: One of your options or stocks trades (`tradeId` from `nexus_trades`): the same row `nexus_trades` lists, with its entries and exits, status and, once closed, realized P&L; an open one carries its latest mark. Someone else's trade is not found

tools.name: nexus_futures_account
tools.section: Nexus: your own simulated trading journal
tools.returns: One futures account as it stands now (`account`: `practice`, the default, `main` for the same, `agent`, `evaluation` or `funded` when you have exactly one running, or an account id): balance, open and day P&L, equity, positions, every resting order and, on an evaluation or funded account, the rules with the room left to each. An account not made yet is not found: a read never makes one

tools.name: nexus_capabilities
tools.section: Nexus: your own simulated trading journal
tools.returns: What your key can do right now: asset classes and order types, the futures contracts and your futures accounts with what each allows, your bot's account, wallets, rate limits and the live stream. The first call sets up your futures practice account if you have none (nothing is placed)

tools.name: account_usage
tools.returns: Balance in credits and US dollars, unlimited flag, and the limits that apply

tools.name: explain_levels
tools.returns: Key dealer-positioning levels for one symbol: spot, King node, flip, largest positive and negative walls, net exposure, five largest levels

tools.name: vol_context
tools.returns: 30-day implied volatility, IV rank, 1-year percentile and range, curve shape, 1-sigma expected moves by horizon (from the current price), scheduled events

tools.name: whats_changed
tools.returns: How one symbol's board moved since an earlier instant: spot move, King node then and now, the five strikes whose net exposure changed most

tools.name: market_brief
tools.returns: VIX complex (computed from the SPX and VIX option chains), market-wide options flow (premium, call/put ratio, net premium, most active) and key levels for SPXW (S&P 500 dailies and weeklies, 0DTE included, as in the app's Trinity view) and QQQ

tools.name: flow_context
tools.returns: Today's flow read for one ticker: bull/bear split and bias, sweep counts and premium, largest recent dark-pool prints
